description: On a new MDB database, DAO creates D(ID LONG primary key) by DDL and appends N and S with TableDef.CreateField(name, 20) (Decimal, no precision or scale given). Then N and S are read from TableDefs (Type, Size, Attributes, and Properties Precision and Scale where present). Seven rows are written by a DAO dynaset AddNew, Field.Value puts (N as BSTR integer text, S as VT_CY) and Update: N = 7, 4294967296, 4294967301, 18446744073709551621, 79228162514264337593543950335, -7, 0; S = 1.5, 0.0001, -2.5, 12345678901234.5678, 0, -0.0001, 3.125. Then, after closing and reopening, asks what DAO Field.Value, SQL CStr(N), CStr(S) and CDbl(N), DAO equality and range filters on N and S, SUM/MAX/MIN of N, ADO Field.Value and ADO GetRows return for those rows.
retentionNote: Designed r-dec-read probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
